{{Quote|Now turn to datapage 2,584 of your ''Expedition'' texts, Volume 56 &hellip;|Barosa Warren|<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
'''''Expedition''''' was a series of texts with at least fifty-six volumes that was produced by the [[Republic Scout Service/Legends|Republic Scout Service]]. [[Barosa Warren]] used the ''Expedition'' texts as the basis of his teachings at the [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]].<ref name="AIR" />
